snippet.title: Barbatus no Majo: Witches of Barbatus (バルバトゥスの魔女) for the NEC PC-88
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

PC-98


Game description:

The country of Barbatus was once ruled by the hero, Barua. Although it prospered as a rich and peaceful country, it was eventually attacked by the army of the Northern Demon King. The Barbatus people struggled, and the wounded Barua fled to the fairyland. The fairyland princess Iserania cared for Barua, and at some point the two fell in love and fought together. They succeeded in containing the Demon King with the magic of Iserania.

However, Balua was hurt and fallen in the battle, and Iserania's life was about to disappear. Death appeared before Iserania and prophesied "Now, does not that all was over. If I Sare this world, one day the Northern Demon King will revive. And, a new true hero will appear at that time."

And at the southern border of the Barbatus nations, which is now divided into three countries, a young man named Gard was about to embark on a trial journey as a ritual of a childhood friend Meer and an adult ...

Barbatus no Majo: Witches of Barbatus is a JRPG where you start off with one character and eventually make your party bigger by having more members. You visit towns and their inns, shops and temples (the latter for healing) and fight monsters in the overworld to get gold and experience points.
What makes this game really special is that it has a day and night cycle.
